remarks: Built in 1892, this designer-owned Victorian has been thoughtfully reimagined for modern living while preserving its original character and architectural integrity. Rooted in Westport's early history, the home reflects a seamless balance between timeless craftsmanship and refined contemporary design.  Influenced by Scandinavian simplicity with subtle Japanese sensibility, the interiors are light-filled, calm, and intentionally curated. A south-facing orientation and skylights fill the home with natural light throughout the day.  The main level offers effortless flow between living, dining, and kitchen spaces, along with a dedicated first-floor office. Three bedrooms and 2.5 baths include a serene primary suite with walk-in closet and ensuite bath featuring understated luxury details.  A walk-up attic offers future expansion potential for a studio, guest suite, or additional bedroom, while the full basement provides generous storage and utility space.  Covered front and rear porches, a private patio, and landscaped grounds extend the living experience outdoors. Extensive updates include a new roof, updated windows, central air, upgraded mechanicals, and enhanced insulation.  Ideally located within walking distance to town, train, and river, this home offers a rare blend of convenience, history, and quiet modern luxury.
